in_english.name: Dionysios
in_english.long_meaning: Dionysios is a Greek name meaning 'son of Zeus', derived from the Greek words 'dios' (of Zeus) and 'ysios' (son). It is a name of biblical significance, as Dionysius was a Christian martyr and bishop of Athens in the 3rd century AD. The name has been used in Christian tradition to signify a powerful and divine connection, and is often associated with qualities such as strength, courage, and spirituality.

saint_reference.note: Saint Dionysius of Athens was a Christian martyr and bishop of Athens in the 3rd century AD.

seo.title: Dionysios: Greek God Turned Christian Symbol
seo.meta_description: Explore the meaning, origin, and religious significance of the Greek name Dionysios, adopted by early Christians as a symbol of the resurrected Christ.
seo.description_paragraph: Dionysios, derived from the Greek word 'dionysos', is the name of the ancient Greek god of wine, festivity, and ecstasy. This name holds deep religious and cultural significance. In Greek mythology, Dionysios was considered the god of the vine, the ivy, the fruit tree, and the panther. He was also known as the Liberator, the Free One, and the King of the Mountains. Although his followers were considered to be wild, they were believed to be free from the usual laws and taboos. When Christianity emerged, the name Dionysios was adopted by early Christians as a symbol of the resurrected Christ and the Holy Spirit. In this context, it is often translated as 'the divine one'.
